correctness.rationale: For 3<=m<=n and 0<=t<=m, any color shared between the bipartition parts must lie on one deleted pair; two different shared colors force m=n=t=3, giving exactly 6 isolated 3-colorings. All no-shared-colorings split into three n-cubes and three m-cubes meeting at the 6 pure corners; each deleted edge contributes six degree-two ears closing squares at the same junctions and no ear-ear edges. Removing an ear excursion reroutes through its junction with unchanged length. A circular coordinate of circumference 3(m+n), alternating 6 cube lengths, gives sharp eccentricity floor(3(m+n)/2), parity and odd-girth 3(m+n); square ears preserve these via first/last-step substitutions. I independently enumerated all proper colorings and one-vertex transitions at (m,n,t)=(3,3,0),(3,3,1),(3,3,2),(3,3,3),(3,4,0),(3,4,1),(3,4,3): verified order and edge formulas, all eccentricities in ordinary cases, and 60+6 isolated states at the exception. Both verify_direct.py and verify_constructive.py source were inspected. Finite samples do not replace general structural proof.
